description: Find LinkedIn profiles from a list of names using LinkedIn's public people directory. No login or cookie needed.

currentCompany.description: Keep only people whose current employer contains this text, e.g. "Microsoft" or "Conrad Labs". Checked against the profile the actor opens for each candidate.
currentCompany.title: Current company

enrichProfiles.description: Open each matched profile's public page to fill photo, about, followers, education and a verified current employer. Turn off for a faster, directory-only result.
enrichProfiles.title: Open each profile for full details

includeHeadlinesFromSearchEngines.description: When the directory has fewer matches than requested, also check public search-engine results for the name. Also recovers indexed headlines. Free and best-effort.
includeHeadlinesFromSearchEngines.title: Use search engines for extra matches and headlines

location.description: Keep only people whose location contains this text, e.g. "London" or "Pakistan".
location.title: Location

maxResultsPerName.description: Maximum profiles to return for each name. LinkedIn's public directory lists up to 50 candidates per name.
maxResultsPerName.title: Max results per name

names.description: Person names to look up. Use a full name ("Satya Nadella"), a single name, or "First Middle Last". Prefix a single term with "first:" or "last:" for a one-sided search.
names.title: Names to search

title: LinkedIn People Search by Name — Input
